metadata.title: Piano Songs by Version and Playing Skills | PianoGrid
metadata.description: Choose a piano piece by its specific arrangement, playing demands and resource access. Compare beginner options and see where to get each version.

h1: Piano Songs: Choose Your Next Piece
intro: Start with a version you can use, not just a song you recognize. Compare the arrangement, the skills it asks for and where its materials are available.

sections.heading: Choose a version, not just a title
sections.body: The same song may have a one-hand melody, an alternating-hands arrangement or a fuller piano part. Difficulty belongs to the version. Publisher level labels are kept separate from PianoGrid’s skill descriptions.

sections.heading: Know where the learning happens
sections.body: An external version opens on its provider’s website. A local practice exercise has its own score and sound demonstration here only after those materials are available. Neither route claims to listen to your playing.

sections.heading: More music to explore
sections.render_existing: Keep the approved topical collections and every useful existing reference. Hide links only when the destination is genuinely unavailable, not because it was not inspected in this research.

schema.name: Piano Songs: Choose Your Next Piece

metadata.title: Easy Piano Songs: Compare Beginner Versions | PianoGrid
metadata.description: Compare specific beginner piano arrangements by the skills, guidance and access they offer. Find the matching sheet-music resource without mixing editions.

intro: Choose a specific arrangement and one achievable goal. “Easy” is not a promise that every version of a song will suit your current skills.

sections.heading: Three versions to compare
sections.render: Shared registry facts plus original editorial guidance; local score/audio buttons remain absent for these external editions.

sections.heading: Choose by what you can already do
sections.body: Use known hand use, rhythm demands and access conditions to narrow the choices. A missing detail means “not verified”, not “easy”. When only a publisher’s level is available, inspect the provider’s sample before committing to the version.

sections.heading: Short original practice exercises
sections.body: These exercises were created for PianoGrid. They are not arrangements of Hot Cross Buns, Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star or Ode to Joy.

sections.heading: More versions and collections
sections.render_existing: Preserve the original nine featured versions, all 50 named collection tracks and kids/C-major/beautiful/adults/impress tasks. Do not relabel the 50 tracks as individually graded or tested.

faqs.question: Does “free” mean I can download a PDF here?
faqs.answer: No. An external free resource may require a form or account on its provider’s website. Only a resource explicitly labelled “Free on PianoGrid” offers local materials.

faqs.question: Does playback check my playing?
faqs.answer: No. Playback demonstrates the selected version or exercise. There is no microphone or MIDI performance assessment in this module.

public_release: Requires actual content rendering, correct capability gating and route checks

metadata.title: Piano Sheet Music: Versions and Access | PianoGrid
metadata.description: Identify a specific piano edition, review its format and access conditions, and find its preview or provider. Local and external resources are clearly separated.

intro: Find the exact edition you intend to learn. Check its notation, the available preview and the conditions for getting your own copy.

sections.heading: Match the score to the version
sections.body: Keep the arranger, edition and key together. A tutorial or audio example from another version may use different notes, hand positions or rhythms.

sections.heading: Choose the right access route
sections.body: Free on PianoGrid, external free, external free with a form or account, external paid, and access not verified are different categories. A provider’s free download is not a permission for this site to redistribute it.

sections.heading: Starting with beginner material
sections.body: Compare identified first-lesson and early-elementary resources. Local original exercises, when available, have their own score and sound demonstration.

sections.heading: Browse the approved collections
sections.render_existing: Keep all approved Sheet Music categories and exact-song tasks; do not activate paused pages automatically.

metadata.title: Easy Piano Sheet Music: Check the Edition | PianoGrid
metadata.description: Compare easy piano editions without treating every easy label as the same level. Check the notation, preview and provider’s printing or download conditions.

intro: An easy-piano label can cover different reading and coordination demands. Use the exact edition and its sample to decide whether it is suitable.

sections.heading: Publisher level and playing demands
sections.body: Publisher labels are reproduced as labels, not converted into exam grades. When range, rhythm or hand information has not been verified, that field stays unfilled.

sections.heading: Need a first-lesson option?
sections.body: Use the beginner collection for a narrower starting point, including identified introductory versions and separately labelled original exercises.

sections.heading: Easy editions and access details
sections.render_existing: Preserve original easy resources; each card resolves the shared arrangement rather than duplicating its licence, key or preview.

public_release: Requires actual content rendering, correct capability gating and route checks

metadata.title: Beginner Piano Sheet Music: Clear Versions and Access | PianoGrid
metadata.description: Find identified beginner piano resources, check how to obtain the exact edition, and distinguish local practice scores from external free or paid materials.

intro: Choose material with a clear starting point and a known access route. Where exact playing demands are unknown, check the provider’s sample rather than assuming a familiar tune is simple.

sections.heading: Original PianoGrid practice scores
sections.body: Short, newly created exercises for counting, bass-clef reading and alternating hands. These are not famous-song arrangements.

sections.heading: Before you print
sections.body: Confirm the title and version, then choose A4 or US Letter when offered. Check that every staff, note label and return link is visible in the print preview. External copies must be obtained under the provider’s conditions.

sections.heading: Looking for finger numbers?
sections.body: Only versions with verified finger-number notation belong in that filter. A keyboard-position graphic or a beginner label does not prove that every note has a finger number.
sections.render_existing: Keep P106 and the existing beginner task; do not count the original exercises as verified fingering coverage.

public_release: Requires actual content rendering, correct capability gating and route checks
